requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

803-1486-4231-5291--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

3168-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Urza's Incubator.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3168-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1770-2226-2805.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-2805.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying its mana cost.
When Kiri-Onna enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-6495-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-6791.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1874-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1739-4200-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3200-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2421-3705-4050-7183.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6669-7202.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Kindle the Inner Flame twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Kindle the Inner Flames, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2511-2842-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2557-3875-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2557-3875-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1283-1978-2416.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Rise and Shine.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3053-4241.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-4241.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Karn.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4785-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1850-2167-4482.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2167-4482.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

252-2073-2292--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

678-5296-6627.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to The Earth Crystal
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

64-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Warden of the Eye.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
64-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Warden of the Eye, causing you to mill cards equal to Warden of the Eye's power.
Cast Warden of the Eye from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4613-4644-5251.easyPrerequisites:
Emmara has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord does not have summoning sickness.
4613-4644-5251.description:
Activate Emmara using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

2523-5147-5558.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1987-2556-4276-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2556-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Revolutionist.
When Mnemonic Wall and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2533-3967-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

914-2034-3249.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-3249.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1558-1800.notablePrerequisites:
Old Gnawbone does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Old Gnawbone.
1558-1800.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Old Gnawbone.
Old Gnawbone triggers, creating seven Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasure tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

500-2556-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-2556-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mnemonic Wall and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Both Mnemonic Wall tokens enter the battlefield, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-2495-3094.description:
Tap Chromatic Orrery for {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tezzeret, targeting Lithoform engine and Chromatic Orrery.
With the ability on the stack, activate Lithoform Engine, copying the ability.
Target Lithoform Engine and Chromatic Orrery with the untap, and let it resolve.
Repeat steps 2-3.
